tokyo-izu-skyline-and-ocean-return.title: Tokyo · Izu Skyline and Ocean Return
tokyo-izu-skyline-and-ocean-return.slogan: A 263 km loop out of Atami fuel and coast
tokyo-izu-skyline-and-ocean-return.story: Skyline curves, hot-spring towns and Pacific air if the weather behaves. Out of Atami and back again: 263 km, roughly 5 h 03 in the saddle. On the way it passes Shuzenji onsen and Ito ocean stop. The climb of the day is Izu Skyline high road. It is a high-mountain day.
